info.title: ERP Mass Mailer & SMS API
info.description: Mass email & SMS campaign management with multi-company LDAP auth.

post.description:
Create an audience: kind='rules' (filter rules) or kind='list'
(static emails/phones, reusable across campaigns).

get.description:
Summary page — list domains show email_count/phone_count, not the
full members (use GET /domains/{id} or /domains/{id}/contacts).
Paginated members of a contact-list domain (emails then phones).

schema.description: Substring match on the contact value.

post.description:
Receives delivery status callbacks from Quantum SMS.

params.message_statuses is a list of {status: [uuids]} dicts.
Each UUID matches dispatch_logs.recipient_ref (stored at send time).

Create a company. Optionally bootstrap everything in one call:
``odoo_source``, ``sms_configs[]`` (with ``provider`` inline),
``email_configs[]``, ``default_sms_provider``, ``generate_api_key``.
A nested validation error aborts the whole creation (no partial
company is left behind).

Generate (or rotate) the sync API key. The old key stops working
immediately — paste the returned key into Odoo right away. Plain key
is shown only here.

get.description: Get per-company Odoo JSON-RPC source config (api_key masked).

put.description:
Create/update the Odoo JSON-RPC source for a company (admin only).

Send api_key only when setting/changing it; omit to leave unchanged.
Set clear_key=true to clear. Enabling requires all four auth fields
(source_url, source_db, source_username, api_key).

post.description: Test the Odoo connection (version + authenticate, no data read).

Pull fields_get from Odoo now and refresh the cache (fallback when
no push arrived). Admin only.

Store the Odoo JSON-RPC credentials (admin only).

Manual: ``{source_url, source_db, source_username, api_key}``.
Auto-mint: ``{source_url, source_db, source_username, password}`` —
the password is used once to ask Odoo to mint a user API key and is
never stored or logged.

Upsert the cached res.partner field schema (called by Odoo push).

Auth: per-company sync API key (``X-API-Key``) — same key Odoo uses
for ``POST /partners/sync``. Humans may also call with JWT.

get.description: Merged local + cached Odoo fields for the domain builder.

Wizard checklist aggregate (no Odoo calls — fast).

Tells the frontend which setup steps are done: sync key, source
credentials, cached schema, first synced partners.

schema.title: Response List Company Email Configs Companies  Company Id  Email Configs Get

post.description:
Create a named SMTP config for a company (admin only).

Any number per company. Set is_default=true to make it the company
default for campaigns without an email_config_id.

patch.description:
Update one email config (admin only).

Send password only when setting/changing it; omit to leave
unchanged. Set clear_password=true to clear. Set is_default=true to
make this config the company default.

delete.description:
Delete an email config (admin only). Clears the company default
when it pointed here; campaigns referencing it then 422 on send.

post.description: Connect + login (when configured), then quit. Never sends mail.

get.description: List per-company SMS provider configs (secrets masked).

schema.title: Response List Company Sms Configs Companies  Company Id  Sms Configs Get

put.description:
Create/update one provider's creds for a company (admin only).

Send secret only when setting/changing it; omit to leave unchanged.
Set clear_secret=true to clear. Set is_default=true to make this
provider the company default.

post.description:
Pre-provision a user (no password — LDAP authenticates).
Optional company_ids in the payload grant company access; change
access later via PATCH /users/{id} — all before the user ever
logs in.

schema.title: Response Get Partner Fields Partners Fields Get

delete.description:
Remove a partner synced from Odoo. Scoped to the caller's company
(from X-API-Key or JWT) — a caller can only delete its own rows.

get.description:
List SMS providers for the frontend campaign dropdown (per-company).

Requires an active company in the JWT (same as /campaigns).

schema.title: Response List Sms Providers Sms Providers Get

get.description:
List the active company's email configs for the campaign dropdown.

Requires an active company in the JWT (same as /sms/providers).

schema.title: Response List Email Configs Email Configs Get

AdminUserCreate.title: AdminUserCreate
AdminUserCreate.description:
Admin-side provisioning. Carries NO password — LDAP owns
authentication, so password_hash always stays NULL on these rows.

q.title: Q
q.description: Substring match on name/email/phone (rules: also applies to the count; hybrid source: filters the local mirror only).

CampaignUpdate.title: CampaignUpdate
CampaignUpdate.description:
Partial update — only provided fields change. Only draft
campaigns can be updated (enforced in the service).

CompanyApiKeyOut.title: CompanyApiKeyOut
CompanyApiKeyOut.description: Returned ONCE at generation — the plain key is never stored/readable.

CompanyCreateResult.title: CompanyCreateResult
CompanyCreateResult.description:
POST /companies/ response: CompanyOut plus the plain sync API key
(shown once, only when generate_api_key=true).

ContactOut.title: ContactOut
ContactOut.description: One member of a contact-list domain.

DomainDetailOut.title: DomainDetailOut
DomainDetailOut.description:
Full shape (GET /domains/{id}) — includes the complete contact
lists for kind='list' domains.

DomainOut.title: DomainOut
DomainOut.description: Summary shape (used in list responses — no heavy contact arrays).

DomainUpdate.title: DomainUpdate
DomainUpdate.description:
Partial update. ``kind`` is immutable — contacts can only be
replaced wholesale on a list domain, rules only on a rules domain
(enforced in the service).

EmailConfigCreate.title: EmailConfigCreate
EmailConfigCreate.description:
Frontend POST body — admin only.

Send password when a username is set; omitting both username and
password creates an unauthenticated relay config.

EmailConfigUpdate.title: EmailConfigUpdate
EmailConfigUpdate.description:
Partial update — only provided fields change.

Omit password to leave it unchanged; set clear_password=true to
clear (only valid when username is also cleared — enforced in the
service final-state check).

OdooSourceProvisionIn.title: OdooSourceProvisionIn
OdooSourceProvisionIn.description:
Body of POST /companies/{id}/source/provision-key (admin only).

Provide EXACTLY one of ``password`` (auto-mint via Odoo, one-time use,
never stored) or ``api_key`` (manual paste fallback).

OdooSourceUpsert.title: OdooSourceUpsert
OdooSourceUpsert.description:
Frontend PUT body — only send api_key when setting/changing it.

Omit api_key to leave unchanged; set clear_key=true to clear.
timeout omitted = global ODOO_SOURCE_TIMEOUT default.
enabled=False keeps the row but disables the source path (hybrid
routing then 422s on non-local fields instead of calling Odoo).

PartnerFieldIn.title: PartnerFieldIn
PartnerFieldIn.description: One field descriptor as pushed by the Odoo module (from fields_get).

q.title: Q
q.description: Substring match on name/email/phone (rules: also applies to the count; hybrid source: filters the local mirror only).

RuleGroup-Input.title: RuleGroup
RuleGroup-Input.description:
Nested filter group: joins its child rules with match (AND/OR)
and optionally negates the whole group (NOT). Children are leaves or
further groups.

RuleGroup-Output.title: RuleGroup
RuleGroup-Output.description:
Nested filter group: joins its child rules with match (AND/OR)
and optionally negates the whole group (NOT). Children are leaves or
further groups.

SmsConfigCreate.title: SmsConfigCreate
SmsConfigCreate.description:
Nested SMS config at company creation: same body as the PUT
/companies/{id}/sms-configs/{provider} route, with the provider inline.

SmsConfigUpsert.title: SmsConfigUpsert
SmsConfigUpsert.description:
Frontend PUT body — only send secret when setting/changing it.

Omit secret to leave unchanged; set clear_secret=true to clear.
sender_id blank/omitted = fall back to global SMS_SENDER_ID.
timeout omitted = global default (10s hubtel/npontu, 30s quantum).
